pages.title: Morioh High FAQ
pages.description: Quick answers about the Roblox game, its developer, availability, community links, and how this independent wiki verifies information.

headings.text: Morioh High FAQ

mainEntity.name: What is Morioh High on Roblox?

acceptedAnswer.text: Morioh High is a Roblox experience by Not A Stand Game. Its official description focuses on school life: attending classes, building relationships, joining groups, exploring, and interacting with NPCs.

mainEntity.name: Who made Morioh High?

acceptedAnswer.text: Roblox lists Not A Stand Game as the developer group. The experience Place ID is 111838814545019 and its Universe ID is 10768944846.

mainEntity.name: Is Morioh High available?

acceptedAnswer.text: The official Roblox API recorded active players on October 11, 2026. That confirms activity at the check time; access for a particular account or device depends on the current Roblox listing.

mainEntity.name: What is the Morioh High release date?

acceptedAnswer.text: BloxInformer lists October 10, 2026, but that exact public release date has not been independently confirmed through a developer announcement here. Roblox records the experience object as created October 2; creation is a different event.

mainEntity.name: Is there a Morioh High Discord?

acceptedAnswer.text: The invite discord.com/invite/moriohhigh resolved to a server named Morioh High when checked on October 11, 2026. It is shared by game-related sources. Developer ownership has not been verified here.

mainEntity.name: Where is the Morioh High Trello?

acceptedAnswer.text: This wiki has not obtained an independently verified board URL. No Trello link is listed as official. Check the developer Roblox community for confirmed resource announcements.

mainEntity.name: Where are the Stand and codes guides?

acceptedAnswer.text: The Stand guide documents fight knockouts, Arrow compatibility, and recorded reroll cost. PC controls and a publisher-reported codes list are available. Code redemption has not been independently tested here, and a complete current Stand roster remains unverified.

mainEntity.name: Where should a Morioh High beginner start?

acceptedAnswer.text: Open the Roblox experience by Not A Stand Game, check the current PC HUD and read Encyclopedia → Stands. The beginner guide links launch steps, recorded controls, Stand awakening and reported codes; a complete current quest walkthrough has not been tested here.

mainEntity.name: Is this an official wiki?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. This is an independent player guide, unaffiliated with Not A Stand Game, Roblox Corporation, and the JoJo rights holders. Sources and check dates explain exactly what each page can support.

mainEntity.name: What key blocks in Morioh High?

acceptedAnswer.text: The checked PC HUD labels F as Block. The footage does not establish a parry window or guarantee that every attack can be blocked.

mainEntity.name: What key uses a Stand skill?

acceptedAnswer.text: The PC HUD labels X as Stand skill and right-click as Stand barrage while a Stand is active. Skill effects and resource costs need separate evidence.

mainEntity.name: How do you withdraw a Stand?

acceptedAnswer.text: The filmed PC prompt labels Z as Withdraw Stand when the Stand is out. Read your current HUD for the action available in its present state.

mainEntity.name: Is Ctrl target lock?

acceptedAnswer.text: The source HUD labels Ctrl only as Lock. This page does not assume a targeting or camera-lock behavior that the selected frame does not demonstrate.

mainEntity.name: Are these mobile or console controls?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. This table records keyboard and mouse prompts. Touch buttons and controller bindings have not been verified for this wiki.

schemas.description: Get your first Morioh High Stand through a qualifying fight or Stand Arrow. Check the Encyclopedia rules and timestamped footage behind each method.

itemListElement.name: How to Get a Stand in Morioh High

mainEntity.name: How do you get your first Stand?

acceptedAnswer.text: The filmed Encyclopedia lists two methods: a qualifying knockout in a real fight, or holding a Stand Arrow until compatibility reaches 100%. The fight method is a chance; the Arrow method is described as certain at full compatibility.

mainEntity.name: Does resetting give you a Stand?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. The filmed Encyclopedia excludes resetting, falling, and a tap at 1 health from qualifying fight knockouts.

mainEntity.name: What is the fight awakening chance?

acceptedAnswer.text: The filmed Encyclopedia states 1 in 10 for a qualifying knockout, with one chance per minute. This is a documented rule from the checked footage, not a rate measured by this wiki.

mainEntity.name: Where do Stand Arrows come from?

acceptedAnswer.text: Checked player footage describes a Stand Arrow event and shows players competing for the Arrow. A fixed spawn route, event interval, and exact holding time have not been verified.

mainEntity.name: Can you choose the Stand you awaken?

acceptedAnswer.text: The filmed Encyclopedia describes the result as random by rarity. This page does not provide an unverified roster or rarity distribution.

mainEntity.name: Are codes required?

acceptedAnswer.text: The two documented awakening methods do not require a code. Working codes and their rewards have not been independently tested here.

mainEntity.name: How many Rerolls does changing a Stand cost?

acceptedAnswer.text: The filmed Encyclopedia shows 100 Rerolls to replace an existing Stand and excludes the current Stand from the result. This is a recorded-build cost; check the price in your current menu before confirming.

itemListElement.name: Morioh High Codes: Reported List and How to Redeem

mainEntity.name: What Morioh High codes are listed here?

acceptedAnswer.text: GAUNTLET, WHITESNAKE, WEHEARYOUGUYS, THANKYOUFORLIKES, DELAYMBALL, PLAYERS5MVBYT, and RELEASECSBKZM appear in both publisher lists checked on October 13, 2026. They are reported codes, not independently tested working codes.

mainEntity.name: How do I redeem a code?

acceptedAnswer.text: Both checked publishers describe opening Menu, selecting Settings, opening Codes, entering a code, and choosing Redeem. MrGuider identifies M as the menu shortcut. Follow your current game interface if it differs; this wiki has not tested redemption.

mainEntity.name: Why are there no reward amounts?

acceptedAnswer.text: The checked sources disagree on at least one reward. This page omits reward descriptions rather than presenting an uncertain amount as confirmed.

mainEntity.name: Are these codes guaranteed to work?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. The publishers list them as active, but this wiki has not confirmed successful redemption or current expiry status. Check the in-game response when trying a code.

mainEntity.name: Do I need to join the Roblox community to redeem?

acceptedAnswer.text: GamesRadar reports joining Not A Stand Game’s Roblox community, then closing and reopening the game before redemption. This is a publisher-reported prerequisite, not a requirement independently tested by this wiki or confirmed in a developer announcement here.

mainEntity.name: Is there a confirmed expired code list?

acceptedAnswer.text: This wiki has not obtained independent expired-code evidence for this list. That does not mean no code has expired. A code missing from a source alone is not proof of expiry.
